units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:4">Ber. V, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Berakhot 34a">34ᵃ</cite>) <he>מפני הטי׳</he> because he might become confused (and be unable to resume his prayers); <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 7">Deut. R. s. 7</cite>, beg.—

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:13">Cant. R. to VIII, 13</cite> <he>בט׳ הדעת</he> in confusion (not in concert).—Tanḥ. Mick. 2 <he>נטרף טרוף אחד</he> had only one trouble (about the interpretation of his dream).—Pl. <cite ref="I00432"><he>טֵירוּפִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="I00432"><he>טֵר׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:13">Ib.</cite> <he>נטרף שני ט׳</he> had two troubles (not knowing even the dream).—
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 296:2">Sifré Deut. 296</cite> (ref. to <he>בדרך</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 25:17">Deut. XXV, 17</cite>) <he>בשעת טֵיוּפֵיכֶם</he> when you were in a state of disorder.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 15">Gen. R. s. 15</cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 139">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXXXIX</cite> (omitt. in ed. Bub.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 887">Yalk. ib. 887</cite> <he>טֵירוּפִי מתוכה</he> my banishment from Eden.
